contract.criterion: Fresh supervisor owner survives inherited STOPPED quiescence and pre-OPEN heartbeat ticks; new same-process shutdown closes, cancels and joins before quiescence.
contract.scope: SOURCE and synthetic DB/transport only; no installed mutation/deployment, model call, native/PG/CLI lifecycle, pins, grants, root, dependencies, docs or global changes.

finding: The model-close drain hook was bound before startup quiescence. The real quiesce calls its drain even when the inherited generation is already quiesced. Binding only after that call is insufficient: pre-OPEN heartbeat ticks repeat the same historical quiescence.
fix: Move initial quiesce before LocalControl starts serving and before binding close hook. Capture startup generation and do not repeat its completed quiescence against the fresh model owner. A new generation uses the existing strict close/cancel/join hook; finalizer remains unchanged.

trace.early_control: LocalControl.__aenter__ starts serving before returning; moved initial quiesce before entering it, so no OPEN/model admission overlaps historical drain. Callback/hook wiring occurs before the first later await.
trace.tick_race: If an owned_status read sees startup generation just before concurrent OPEN/SHUTDOWN, this tick skips quiesce entirely, never writes a premature receipt; next tick observes changed generation and closes normally. DB Stop fences unchanged.
trace.finalizer: Unchanged close_model_test then runtime.drain then close/release/dispose; startup failure and early-close covered.
